text: Idea cursor: one row key instead of selection fields scattered over entities
description: Slice 3 of 562cdb60. Replace phase.selectedIdeaIndex (a UI field on data-store Phase entities), floatingIdeaIndex and the nested AimUIState.selectedIncomingIndex chains with one cursor row key per list, e.g. the aimId path. Derive the selection path from it; move-actions (J/K/H/L, x/p) and restore/persist use the same key. Should be decided together with the phase selection model question (focused entry + derived path + children remembered by id, explicit scroll intents); see 98f05e67.

status.comment: Decided by Felix 2026-10-16: a single focused entry in the list UI, with the path derived from it. Phase columns already work this way (selectedEntryKeyByColumn). Checked 2026-10-17: the idea cursor is not refactored yet. phase.selectedIdeaIndex, uiStore.floatingIdeaIndex and selectedIncomingIndex still carry it, about 200 uses in 25 frontend files (move-actions, list-store, ui-persistence, keyboard-actions, navigation-helpers, data.ts and their specs).
